title: Scanning
body: Set the cube down and right-click it: it rises, a grid grows out of it, and the ball of the world around it, fifteen blocks across, is digitized: the blocks, what is in the chests, signs, banners and beds, frames and armor stands, the animals and mobs, and the time and weather.
Sneak + right-click (or hit it) to pick it up with its scan. Sneak + right-click in the air with it wipes the scan.
